title: Procedural Preview Rectangle Extrude
description: Fix procedural 3D preview not updating when typing rectangle via spotlight, setting width/height sliders, and extruding.
summary: Fixed procedural 3D preview for sketch rectangle and extrude. Root cause: brepjs sketchRectangle/sketchExtrude produced invalid drawing/solid geometry (FACE_BUILD_FAILED / NaN bounds) that tessellation could not render. sketchRectangleSync and drawRectangleSync now register previewable solid profile boxes with rectangle profile metadata; sketchCircleSync/drawCircleSync use cylinder profiles. extrudeSync reads profile metadata to build box/cylinder solids instead of broken sketchExtrude. Drawing tessellation falls back to wire edge mesh when available. Fixed boundsToAabb for brepjs getBounds format. Fixed duplicate Button import blocking procedural play compile. Verified: geometry/brep/js 9/9 tests pass; evaluateBrepFlowKind rectangle+extrude chain tessellates.
